description_en: Queries the source topics subscribed to by a specified custom topic, that is, the reverse route table
description_zh: 查询指定自定义Topic订阅的源Topic，即反向路由表
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-topic-reverse-route-table --iot-instance-id iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --topic /x7aWKW9000/testDataToDataHub/user/update --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryTopicReverseRouteTable

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>ID value is displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无<props="intl"><ph>**实例概览**页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the device resides (corresponding to the region in the console), such as cn-shanghai.

> This parameter is already included in the common request parameters and does not need to be passed as an API-specific parameter
parameters.help_zh:
设备所在地域（与控制台上的地域对应），如cn-shanghai。

> 目前此参数已包含在公共请求参数中，不再作为API特有参数传入
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The destination topic to query, that is, the topic that receives messages
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的目标Topic，即接收消息的Topic
parameters.name: topic
